name: dockyardos-vscode
description: Universal control center for persistent AI development orchestration, memory, connectors, skills, verification and safe automation.

dockyardOS.cliPath.description: Optional external DockyardOS CLI executable. Leave blank to use the Core bundled inside the VS Code extension.

dockyardOS.defaultHost.description: Default coding-agent host for one-click initialization and host checks.

dockyardOS.defaultMode.description: Default DockyardOS operating mode used by Auto Initialize.

dockyardOS.autoInitialize.enabled.description: Automatically initialize DockyardOS project state when a trusted workspace opens. Disabled by default.

dockyardOS.autoInitialize.installHostInt.description: When Auto Initialize runs, also install/update the selected default agent-host integration using the configured scope.

dockyardOS.autoInitialize.hostScope.description: Default host-integration scope used by Auto Initialize. User scope is normally the easiest universal setup.

dockyardOS.dashboard.openOnStartup.description: Open the DockyardOS Control Center when a trusted project workspace starts.

dockyardOS.communityUpdates.enabled.description: Periodically check installed DockyardOS community packages for immutable candidate updates. Disabled by default and never runs in untrusted workspaces.

dockyardOS.communityUpdates.intervalMinu.description: Minutes between scheduled community update checks. DockyardOS enforces a minimum of 60 minutes and maximum of 7 days.

dockyardOS.communityUpdates.applySafeAut.description: Opt in to unattended activation only for updates that remain automatic after the existing fresh pinned apply-safe assessment. Approval-required, quarantined, ambiguous, missing, or risk/trust-escalated updates are never auto-approved.

dockyardOS.communityUpdates.notifyWhenNo.description: Show a VS Code notification when a scheduled update check finds everything up to date.

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check extension.js && node --check dashboard-controller.js && node --check dashboard-view.js && node --check ui-theme.js && node --check connections-controller.js && node --check connections-model.js && node --check connections-view.js && node --check community-hub-model.js && node --check community-hub-view.js && node --check community-update-scheduler.js && node --check partner-offers.js && node --check scripts/generate-partner-offers.cjs && node --check scripts/prepare-core.cjs
scripts.package: npm run generate-partners && npm run prepare-core && npx @vscode/vsce package
